prompt: A small puff of dust kicked up by a heavy foot stomp on a stage floor, pixel art, plays once, about 0.6 seconds. A low ring of tan-beige dust grains bursts outward and a few particles rise and fade. Colours: sandy beige and light brown-grey. message: A 32×32 one-shot stage-stomp dust puff, about 0.6 seconds: a low flattened ring of sandy-beige grains bursts outward, a faint brown-grey dust cloud sits at the base, and a few specks drift up and fade. Try the Speed slider on the grain ring for a wider or tighter burst; I pulled the ring in so it stays inside the canvas.
